Dear Jan, Pete and Carol,

The park bill for next year has come in at £5,087 all in. Split four ways same as always, between me, Jan, Pete and Carol, that works out at £1,271.75 each. It has gone up again, near £350 on last year, but the park sets the fees and there is nothing I can do about it.

Please can you get the money to me by 31 January, into the same account as before, as the park wants the lot by then. If anyone would rather pay in two lots that is fine, £635.87 in December and £635.88 in January. Just let me know which you are doing.

Me and Bev, 5-12 June, handover on the 5th.
Pete and Linda, 29 May to 5 June, May half term.
Carol, Easter week and a week in September.
Jan, 7th to 14th August.

No clashes this year so everyone has what they asked for. Carol, I will sort the exact September dates with you once I have checked the school holidays.

Pete, you mentioned the shower tray. I went up on 26 October and put a new one in, £140 for the parts. I am not putting that on the bill, it is done with.

And the park has said caravans over 15 year old need a condition survey before the 2028 season. Ours is 16 year old now so that will be coming round, I just want everyone to know in advance so nobody gets a surprise.

Any problems give me a ring.

Regards
Mick
